shape: Simple T-junction (3 portals: S, W, E)
description: Three-portal T-junction with a sparse backbone — each gate has its own staging anchor, and a single south-side hub (y5kk5n) joins the south + west arms. The east arm connects via a short east corridor (89yh42 → eoad0m). Cleanest T-junction in valley-B.

portals.south: spawn_south at (17.09, 16.12) — gate on the south (high-Z) side
portals.west: spawn_west at (-22.14, 17.04) — gate on the west (low-X) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.31, -14.43) — gate on the east (high-X) side

anchors.description: south entry hub — joins west arm + east corridor (matches y5kk5n)

traversalNotes: south ↔ west: spawn_south → south_inner → west_arm → spawn_west. 3 hops.
south ↔ east: spawn_south → south_inner → east_mid → east_inner → spawn_east. 4 hops.
west ↔ east:  spawn_west → west_arm → south_inner → east_mid → east_inner → spawn_east. 5 hops.
south_inner is the canonical junction anchor. Cleanest T-junction we've authored.
